description: Groups of pages that should be merged or redirected into a stronger page, with what to do with each competing page and why. Pages with a distinct intent are kept. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.
